subject: Q4 demo rebooking request — EMEA customer offsite conflict
messages:
From: Anna Kovács <anna.kovacs@healthlytix.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@healthlytix.com
Date: 2026-05-12T08:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Demo scheduled 2026-05-18 — need to move (MedData offsite)

Hi Tessa,

I sent a calendar RSVP earlier but wanted to follow up here — our exec and product teams will be at the MedData Summit in Barcelona during the week of the 18th and the wider company is closing for a regional offsite on the 19th. That means most of the stakeholders who asked to be in the demo (exec + infra leads) are unavailable.

Can we rebook the demo to the first week of June? Ideally a 60-minute session with a short technical deep dive followed by Q&A. If you have a short pre-recorded walkthrough we can share internally, that would be helpful so we don't lose momentum.

Attaching our internal availability as an .ics — we can be flexible afternoons CET. Also flagging our procurement/legal team will want to see the brief before we proceed (they asked for the architecture overview).

Thanks — Anna
Anna Kovács
Director of Product | Healthlytix
anna.kovacs@healthlytix.com
+44 20 7946 0821

Attachment: calendar-options.ics (availability grid, 3 slots)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Kovács <anna.kovacs@healthlytix.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Demo scheduled 2026-05-18 — need to move (MedData offsite)

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the MedData Summit slot. Totally understand the blackout during the offsite.

We can absolutely move the session. Two options to keep momentum:
- Option A (recommended): Live 60-min demo the week of June 1 — we’ll do a 30-min product + 30-min tech Q&A. Soojin (CC) can own the deep-dive if Marcus is tied up.
- Option B: Send a ~12-minute recorded walkthrough this week for you to share with execs, followed by a 30-min live Q&A the week after (good if schedules remain tight).

I attached a short demo brief (demo-brief.pdf) that covers agenda, outcomes, and the architecture slide you mentioned — happy to route an expanded architecture doc to your procurement team once you confirm which option you prefer.

Please let us know two preferred 60-min windows (CET) and we’ll send updated invites.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0147
E: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: demo-brief.pdf, calendar-options.ics
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Anna Kovács <anna.kovacs@healthlytix.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Demo scheduled 2026-05-18 — need to move (MedData offsite)

Tessa / Anna — I can cover the live deep-dive. Quick notes on execution and coverage: 

1) If we go Option A (live 60): I’ll prepare a focused 30-min technical demo that highlights latency/cost dashboards, routing fallbacks, and a short inference performance comparison on an EMEA dataset you mentioned. Marcus — if you can bring the integration roadmap bullets (2–3 items) that’ll help structure the Q&A.

2) If Option B (recording + Q&A): I can record the 12-min walkthrough by Friday (will upload to our portal and share a private link). I recommend a 30-min live Q&A slot in week of June 7 (Tues/Wed afternoons CET).

I updated HubSpot with the proposed follow-up activities and added a DocuSign reminder for the NDAs we discussed last month: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/Healthlytix

I’ll also set up two provisional invites (June 2 15:00 CET and June 8 14:00 CET) — please confirm which to finalize.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com

- Can you include the architecture slide with data residency notes (we’re in multiple EU regions)? Procurement wants that up front.
